artworks.title: Telemachus and Nestor
artworks.description: Lagrenée's shore at Pylos — the old king who came home without poison and later counselled Odysseus' son at Poseidon's sacrifice.

artworks.title: Nestor
artworks.description: Stieler's counsellor of Troy — the horseman whose ninety ships returned intact to sandy Pylos.

artworks.title: The Embarkation of Nestor
artworks.description: Villenave's departure for Troy reversed — the Neleid king's nostos, the one homecoming the Epic Cycle tells without treachery.
